cli.description: QuickJS WASM serverless backend — backend runs in the browser, no server required
cli.langHint: Tip: run 'dok lang' to change the CLI language (한국어/English/日本語/中文/...).

cmd.create: Create a new dokkebi project with interactive CLI (Nuxt-style)
cmd.build: Build backend with QuickJS WASM and integrate with the frontend
cmd.serve: Serve the built dist folder via static server (no special WASM headers needed)
cmd.deploy: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages + optional S3 frontend upload
cmd.migrate: Apply backend/db/migrations/*.sql files to the database
cmd.dev: Run the dev server (auto-build + hot reload + log collection)
cmd.update: Apply latest dokkebi version update to existing project (worker files + system tables)
cmd.policyScaffold: Auto-generate Tenant/Authorization Policy from static analysis of models + controllers (inserts into dokkebi.config.js)
cmd.lang: Change the CLI language (12 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, etc.)
cmd.security: Summarize security opt-in flags from dokkebi.config.js (no build)

opt.skipBuild: Skip build and start server immediately
opt.securityStatus: Print one-shot text summary only (CI / non-TTY)
opt.securityInteractive: Force interactive TUI even without a TTY
opt.backendOnly: Deploy backend only (Cloudflare Pages, skip frontend)
opt.frontendTarget: Frontend deploy target override (cloudflare-pages | cloudflare-r2 | s3)
opt.strictRegistry: Abort deploy if Query Registry is empty (force strict mode)
opt.allowEmptyRegistry: [deprecated] not needed in auto mode; ignored when strict
opt.rebuild: Force full rebuild even if dist exists
opt.skipCliUpdate: Skip CLI (npm) self-update; update project files only

cp .env.example .env   # Fill in DB credentials, then
    dok build              # Migrate + build

dok deploy       # Auto-deploy to Cloudflare Pages
                     # (auto-installs wrangler, registers Worker secrets)

create.devServerCmd: dok serve        # Serve build + DB proxy + log collection
create.webauthnGuide:
You must wire these two calls into your sign-up/login code for protection:
     1) Right after successful sign-up:
          await dokkebi.webauthn.register({ userId, userName });
     2) Right after successful login:
          await dokkebi.webauthn.authenticate({ userId });
   Without wiring, "security.webauthn.enabled: true" has no effect.
   Guide: docs/design/WEBAUTHN.md

baseline.body:
ECDH handshake, AES-256-GCM, HMAC, Replay (nonce + time), SQL Allowlist, Query Registry defaults, Opaque Handle, etc. are **always on** and cannot be turned off here.
See docs/SECURITY_OPTIN.md (top).

level.attack: Misconfiguration that weakens tenant, authz, and registry together
level.body:
`basic`: no preset (legacy).
`standard`: Tenant verify + Authorization warn + queryRegistry on + autoApply.
`strict`: Tenant inject + Authorization strict + queryRegistry strict.

queryRegistry.attack: Disallowed SQL or misuse of learn/auto modes
queryRegistry.body: `enabled: false` is rare. `strict: true` blocks empty-registry deploys, etc.

policy.body: Per-table tenant column checks/injection. Draft with `dok policy:scaffold`.

authorization.attack: Normal users calling admin-only SQL ops

capabilities.attack: Auth-bypass and direct calls to paid/costly APIs
capabilities.body: Worker-signed short-lived tokens before route execution.

attestation.body: When capabilities are on, attestation defaults on. Set `enabled: false` explicitly to turn off.

panelIpGuard.attack: Admin panel brute force / panel API from arbitrary IPs

activeDefense.attack: Automated scraping, failures, risky behavior spikes
activeDefense.body: `monitor` logs only; `enforce` blocks. Lazy trigger by default.

webauthn.body: Passkey request signing. **App code** must wire register/authenticate.

strictCsp.attack: XSS chaining to external scripts / eval
strictCsp.body: Strict CSP limiting inline scripts; third-party scripts may need allowlist tweaks.

bundleEncrypt.attack: Static download of full guest backend source from CDN
bundleEncrypt.body: Default ON: `dok build` runs JS obfuscation + AES-256-GCM on the backend bundle; key via handshake (`__DOKKEBI_BC_KEY__`). For plain `backend-bundle.js` only, set `security.bundleEncrypt: false` or env `DOKKEBI_BUNDLE_ENCRYPT=off`.

advisor.attack: Cost routes missing capability declarations (human error)
advisor.body: Warnings on `dok build`. Disable with `security.advisor.disable: true`.

needs.policy: When ON: define `policy.tables` tenant columns|Inject identifiers in session (e.g. ctx.setSessionTenant) per sessionClaim|Run `dok build`
needs.authorization: `.env` / Pages Secret: `DOKKEBI_JWT_SECRET` (or jwtSecretEnv)|Requests include `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`|Rules: `authorization.rules` or policy:scaffold|Run `dok build`
needs.capabilities: `DOKKEBI_CAPABILITY_SECRET` (32+ random chars)|`security.capabilities.features` or `@dokkebi-capability` JSDoc|Run `dok build` (router guards)
needs.webauthn: docs/design/WEBAUTHN.md|Wire SDK in signup/login flows|Run `dok build`
needs.strictCsp: If front build breaks, adjust domains/hashes|Run `dok build`
needs.bundleEncrypt: When ON: register `__DOKKEBI_BC_KEY__` / `__DOKKEBI_BC_KEY_MAP__` as Pages Secret per deploy docs|Run `dok build`
